summary:
Successfully implemented KAFKA-20368 by using LinkedHashMap for deterministic metric tags order in RLMExpirationTask. 

Changes made:
1. Added import: org.apache.kafka.common.metrics.internals.MetricsUtils
2. Modified RLMExpirationTask.metricTags from HashMap to LinkedHashMap initialization via MetricsUtils.getTags()
3. Updated constructor to use MetricsUtils.getTags("topic", topicIdPartition.topic(), "partition", Integer.toString(topicIdPartition.partition()))

Result: All 89 tests pass. Metric tags now have deterministic order (topic before partition) instead of non-deterministic HashMap ordering.
